cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've pulled a chair out like you. Seats saved. I wasn't just late to the reunion; can I tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved that chair so people could get past. At the reunion I did save you one. Was it traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, keep the way clear. I waited outside for half an hour. Will you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd enjoy yourself more without me. Will you sit beside me now?
